x: Rajanatha Dindima, court poet of Saluva Narasimha, wrote Saluvabhyudayam. Gangadevi wrote Madhura Vijayam, not Saluvabhyudayam; Dhurjati wrote Sri Kalahasteeswara Mahatyam and Satakam, not Madhura Vijayam; Ramabhyudayamu is by Ayyalaraju Ramabhadrudu, while Tirumalamba wrote Varadambika Parinayam.

Madalasa Charita, Rasamanjari and Jnana Chintamani are Sanskrit works of Krishnadevaraya, so pairs 1-3 are correct. Pair 4 is wrong: Satyavadhu Parinayam is also a Sanskrit work, not Telugu; his only Telugu work is Amuktamalyada. So 1, 2 and 3 only.
